My first thoughts, probably same as most people when joining were: "how can I help" and "how can I get involved".

It's great that there is a bitcoin and paypal account set up to receive donations - I will be donating $15 as soon as it gets deposited to my paypal wallet and its very encouraging to see many other people making similar contributions. I wonder if improvements could be sped up if there was a central place for community feedback to help improve and give ideas about the future of this site. (I couldn't find one easily)

A couple of things I would initially like to mention:

Positive Characteristics of VOAT - The chat room feature on this sub is Brilliant, and I think it is a great enhancement.

  • I like the layout, and its familiarity to reddit's user friendly interface

  • Obviously the laissez-faire moderation policy of this site is what will make it thrive and surpass reddit.

Potential Improvement Suggestions*

  1. I noticed that u/Atko seems to be the only lead mod, and the one in charge of v/announcements and while he is doing a fantastic job, I bet that he could use some help which brings me to my next suggestion

  2. Opening a subscription feature similar to reddit gold to allow users to support and help pay for server time for the community.

  3. Also, I'm sure this will probably come in time but I would definitely buy a Voat shirt and other Voat merchandise to help support the community and show my pride. Although I am just joining, if this site even barely makes strides towards what it has the potential to become, it will be a site to be proud of.

So with those initial thoughts, I just wanted to say hi to my fellow Voaters (or goats - because of the mascot?) and to add my voice to the mix of so many other great individuals who are trying to make this place one that is a beacon of intellectual and free speech where all have a voice, no matter what their opinion.
